1651-1770-6754-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-6754-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-6754-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

4009-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4009-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast Mox Opal by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Opal enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Opal by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Mox Opal, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Opal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

339-677-728-1251.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-856-5270.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

3175-5617-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1671-4693-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

4275-5003-5256-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
4275-5003-5256-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1778-2292-2626-4986.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Memnite.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-3151-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-6791.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3188-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
3188-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7725.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4419-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
4419-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Renata.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2388-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3220-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

3209-7117.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat.

5231-6517-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6642-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6642-6968.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6642-6968.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

2275-3532-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

628-3108-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.
628-3108-6798.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

2440-6873.description:
Activate Fire Nation Archers by paying {5}, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and creating a 2/2 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Fire Nation Archers by paying {5}, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and creating a 2/2 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes triggers. 
Resolve the Mana Echoes triggers from steps 2 and 4, adding {C}{C} for each Soldier you control.
Activate Fire Nation Archers by paying {5}, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and creating a 2/2 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat from step 6.
2440-6873.notes: The starting mana cost assumes you control no other Soldiers when starting the combo. If you control more Soldiers, the mana needed is as follows: {10} for one Soldier, {8} for two Soldiers, {6} for three Soldiers and {5} for four or more Soldiers. If you control two or more Soldiers, only perform steps 6 through 8.

969-2457-4289-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1737-2793-5315.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {5} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by acrificing the Ugin's Nexus token.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Timeless Witness

2665-4823-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2665-4823-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the token Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

501-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

851-2143.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

372-1938-2705.manaNeeded: {2}{W}, plus an additional {W} if Glorious Protector was not foretold
372-1938-2705.description:
Cast Glorious Protector by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Suspension Field to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Suspension Field enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector until Suspension Field leaves the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Suspension Field and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Glorious Protector to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-4050-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two 1/1 Sliver creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Slivers, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1671-1912-3869-4826.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield untapped due to Archelos, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Gretchen Titchwillow by paying {G}{U}, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1284-1636-4133.notablePrerequisites:
Viridian Longbow attached to Soul Collector.
Soul Collector does not have summoning sickness.
A player controls a nontoken creature with toughness equal to one.
1284-1636-4133.description:
Activate Soul Collector by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature with toughness equal to one.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Soul Collector, returning the creature from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2034-2162-2308-3000.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2034-2162-2308-3000.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The creatures die, triggering Soul Net twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1} to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2103-2556-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2103-2556-3742.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall that is tapped and attacking.
Mnemonic Wall enters, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

411-3168-4720-4893.notablePrerequisites: Urza's Incubator chose Elemental on ETB.
411-3168-4720-4893.description:
Pay {R} to return Grinning Ignus to your hand, adding {R}{C}{C}.
Cast Grinning Ignus for {R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast for {C} to add {R} leaving you where you started with with an additional {1}.
Repeat for infinite mana.

601-2102-3206.notablePrerequisites: Manascape Refractor does not have summoning sickness.
601-2102-3206.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Mutavault's second ability by paying {1}, causing Manascape Refractor to become a 2/2 creature with all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Manascape Refractor and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2.
